arXiv:2605.07930v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 8 日arXiv:2605.07930v1 [cs.LG] 08 May 2026

INO-SGD：解决公用事业不平衡问题INO-SGD: Addressing Utility Imbalance
个性化差异隐私under Individualized Differential Privacy

Xiao Tian1,21{,}2, Jue Fan1,21{,}2, Rachael Hwee Ling Sim11 & Bryan Kian Hsiang Low11
11Department of Computer Science, National University of Singapore
22Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Singapore
{xiao.tian, jue.fan, rachael.sim}@u.nus.edu
lowkh@comp.nus.edu.sg
摘要Abstract

差异化隐私Differential privacy（DP）广泛应用于机器学习中，以保护机密或敏感的训练数据不被泄露。随着数据所有者因个人数据所有权而对其数据获得更大的控制权，他们更有可能设定自己的隐私要求，从而需要(DP) is widely employed in machine learning to protect confidential or sensitive training data from being revealed. As data owners gain greater control over their data due to personal data ownership, they are more likely to set their own privacy requirements, necessitating个性化DPindividualized DP(IDP) 来满足此类请求。特别是，来自更敏感子集的数据所有者（例如污名化疾病的阳性病例）可能会设定更严格的隐私要求，因为此类数据的泄露可能会产生更严重的社会影响。然而，现有的 IDP 算法会引发一个关键的问题(IDP) to fulfil such requests. In particular, owners of data from more sensitive subsets, such as positive cases of stigmatized diseases, likely set stronger privacy requirements, as leakage of such data could incur more serious societal impact. However, existing IDP algorithms induce a critical效用失衡utility imbalance问题：problem:来自具有更强隐私要求的所有者的数据可能在训练模型中严重不足，导致部署期间后续用户的类似数据的性能较差Data from owners with stronger privacy requirements may be severely underrepresented in the trained model, resulting in poorer performance on similar data from subsequent users during deployment。在本文中，我们分析了这个问题并提出了. In this paper, we analyze this problem and propose theINO-SGD算法，该算法策略性地降低每个批次中数据的权重，以提高所有迭代中更私有数据的性能。值得注意的是，我们的算法是专门为满足 IDP 而设计的，而解决效用不平衡的现有技术既不能满足 IDP，也不能轻松适应。最后，我们证明了我们方法的实证可行性。algorithm, which strategically down-weights data within each batch to improve performance on the more private data across all iterations. Notably, our algorithm is specially designed to satisfy IDP, while existing techniques addressing utility imbalance neither satisfy IDP nor can be easily adapted to do so. Lastly, we demonstrate the empirical feasibility of our approach.

1 简介Introduction

机器学习 (ML) 专注于构建Machine learning (ML) focuses on building a型号model从现有的中汲取模式that draws patterns from existing数据data以便可以应用于未来的预测任务。由于数据至关重要但又始终稀缺，so that it can be applied to future prediction tasks. Since data is essential yet always scarce,模特拥有者model owners拥有并训练 ML 模型的人通常必须从个人那里收集数据who possess and train ML models often have to collect data from individual数据所有者data owners。例如，医疗机构从医院获取数据来训练预测心脏病风险的模型. For example, medical institutes acquire data from hospitals to train a model that predicts the risk of heart diseases(Panagopoulos et al., 2022)。为了构建最佳模型，理想情况下应该允许模型所有者不受限制地使用所有数据。然而，当某些第三方用户访问经过训练的模型时，这会给数据所有者的隐私带来潜在威胁。例如，对抗性技术，例如. To build the best model, model owners should ideally be allowed to use all data without restrictions. However, this brings potential threat to data owners’ privacy when some third-party users access the trained model. For example, adversarial techniques such as成员资格推断攻击membership inference attacks (Shokri et al., 2017)可以泄露身份或敏感数据。因此，模型所有者必须can reveal identity or sensitive data. Thus, model owners must确保ensure数据隐私data privacy训练模型时when training models以实现长期健康的合作。to achieve a long-term healthy collaboration.

现有的作品已经建立了先进的技术来表示和保护隐私。Existing works have established advanced techniques to represent and preserve privacy.差异化隐私Differential privacy(DP) 介绍者(DP) introduced byDwork (2006)是一种被广泛接受的隐私措施。 DP 背后的核心直觉是，如果对于任何个人数据，个人信息都会受到保护is a widely accepted measure of privacy. The core intuition behind DP is that personal information is protected if for any individual datumdd，任何数据集, any dataset withdd结果是经过训练的模型与在同一数据集上训练的另一个模型几乎没有区别results in a trained model that is almost indistinguishable from another model trained on the same dataset withoutdd关于预定的with regards to a predetermined隐私预算privacy budget由数据所有者设置。然后，潜在的攻击者无法从训练后的模型中确定数据集中是否存在单个数据。基于DP，许多set by data owners. Then a potential attacker cannot tell for certain from the trained model whether an individual datum is present in the dataset. Based on DP, many差分隐私机器学习differentially private ML（DP-ML）技术已经开发和部署，包括(DP-ML) techniques have been developed and deployed, including差分隐私随机梯度下降differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) (Abadi et al., 2016)，其中高斯噪声用于扰动每个 SGD 步骤的梯度。, where Gaussian noise is used to perturb the gradient at each SGD step.

随着数据保护和隐私意识的不断提高，许多法律已经合法执行With rising awareness of data protection and privacy, many laws have legally enforced个人数据所有权personal data ownership，例如, such as一般数据保护条例General Data Protection Regulation（通用数据保护条例）(GDPR)(Regulation, 2018)在欧盟和in the European Union and加州消费者隐私法California Consumer Privacy Act（CCPA）(CCPA)(Pardau, 2018)在美国。此类法律规定数据是其所有者的合法财产，数据所有者有权决定模型所有者可以使用其数据的程度，从而表明他们自己的隐私要求。在实践中，in the United States. Such laws state that data are legal properties of their owners, which entitle data owners to decide the extent to which model owners can use their data and hence indicate their own privacy requirements. In practice,不同数据所有者的隐私要求可能有所不同privacy requirements can vary across data owners (Berendt et al., 2005; Jensen et al., 2005)。例如，来自更敏感子集的数据所有者（例如，污名化疾病的阳性病例、历史上处于不利地位的种族）可能需要在分类任务中提供更强的隐私性，因为数据泄漏可能会导致歧视或拒绝服务. For example, owners of data from more sensitive subsets (e.g., positive cases of stigmatized diseases, historically disadvantaged races) may require stronger privacy in classification tasks as data leakage could incur discrimination or denial of services(Best and Arseniev-Koehler, 2023; Lai and Tanner, 2022)。 乍一看，模型所有者可以满足这样的要求. At first glance, a model owner can fulfil such个性化差异隐私individualized differential privacy(IDP) 要求，维护所有数据所有者的最强隐私级别。(IDP) requirements by maintaining the strongest level of privacy across all data owners.然而，正如所描述的However, as described by the隐私与效用的权衡privacy-utility tradeoff (Makhdoumi and Fawaz, 2013)，使用最强的 DP 级别会降低训练后的 ML 模型的效用（性能）。, using the strongest DP level undesirably reduces the utility (performance) of the trained ML model.为了尽可能地利用每个所有者的隐私预算（以获得最高的效用），To exploit each owner’s privacy budget as much as possible (to attain highest utility),Boenisch et al. (2024)提议proposes个性化DP-SGDindividualized DP-SGD (IDP-SGD)实现IDP，我们在第2节详细介绍。to achieve IDP, which we introduce in detail in Sec.2.1.

然而，However,（一）(I) 确实doesIDP-SGD有什么限制，例如当数据空间内持有不同组数据的数据所有者有不同的隐私要求时？have any limitation, such as when data owners holding different groups of data within the data space have different privacy requirements?例如，在For example, in分类classification问题是，每个类可能有不同的隐私要求；不同地区的隐私要求可能有所不同problems, each class might have different privacy requirements; privacy requirements may vary across类别categories共享相似特征的数据（例如，同一疾病的不同类型）。 在秒。of data sharing similar traits (e.g., different types of the same disease). In Sec.3.1，我们证明, we show thatIDP-SGD有以下问题has the following issue：当拥有专有数据的数据所有者有不同的 IDP 要求时，经过训练的 ML 模型对于更多的私有所有者来说可能具有较低的效用。 在部署过程中，不平衡的公用事业将对受模型决策影响的模型所有者（例如，具有疾病模型的医疗机构）和后续用户（例如，与更多私人所有者患有相同疾病的患者）产生负面影响。 这引出了下一个问题：: when data owners with exclusive data have different IDP requirements, the trained ML model may have lower utilities for the more private owners. During deployment, the imbalanced utilities will negatively affect the model owner (e.g., medical institute with a disease model) and subsequent users (e.g., patients with the same diseases as the more private owners) affected by the model’s decisions. This leads to the next question:（二）(II) 我们可以主动纠正这个问题吗Can we proactively correct this国内流离失所者引发的效用失衡IDP-induced utility imbalance跨数据所有者？across data owners?为了解决这个问题，我们建议To address this, we propose the个性化噪声有序 SGDindividualized noisy ordered SGD (INO-SGD)秒中的算法。algorithm in Sec.3.2。我们的关键想法是. Our key idea is that我们应该降低某些不太重要的梯度的权重，在我们的例子中，这会损害模型，因为它们会加剧不平衡并分散模型学习更困难数据的注意力，这些数据可能来自更多私人所有者或来自更少私人所有者的更难预测的数据we should down-weight certain less important gradients, which in our case harm the model, as they worsen the imbalance and distract the model from learning the more difficult data, which would be from the more private owners or harder-to-predict data from less private owners。 重要的是，该算法必须经过专门设计，才能满足每个数据所有者的 IDP 要求，我们将在第 2 节中进行解释。. Importantly, the algorithm has to be specially designed such that it still satisfies each data owner’s IDP requirement, and we explain in Sec.3.1为什么解决数据不平衡的现有技术不能轻易适应这一点。我们从理论上分析了好处why existing techniques addressing data imbalance cannot be easily adapted to do so. We theoretically analyze the benefits ofINO-SGD在秒。in Sec.3.3并在第二节中展示其实证表现。and demonstrate its empirical performance in Sec.4.

However, this is not true under (I)DP which only allows a limited number of iterations. 国内流离失所者引起的效用失衡是不可取的。Undesirability of IDP-induced utility imbalance.

如果 ML 模型在某些群体中的效用明显较低（例如，由于阳性病例患者具有更强的 IDP 要求），则受模型决策影响的模型所有者和在该群体中拥有数据的后续用户都会受到影响。因此，模型所有者必须在训练期间解决这种由 IDP 引起的效用不平衡问题，以提高部署期间处境最差群体的效用（参见 App.If the ML model has significantly lower utility on some group (e.g., due to positive-case patients having stronger IDP requirements), the model owner and subsequent users with data in such group who are impacted by the model decisions are affected. Thus, the model owner must address such IDP-induced utility imbalance during training to improve the utilities of worst-off groups during deployment (see App.A.3).

现有工程不适合。Unsuitability of existing works.

应用程序。App.B.3对与效用失衡相关的现有工作（可能是松散的）以及它们不适合解决 IDP 下 IDP 引起的效用失衡问题进行了详细审查。总而言之，我们将现有作品分为三类：gives a detailed review of existing works (possibly loosely) related to utility imbalance and their unsuitability to tackle IDP-induced utility imbalance under IDP. To summarize, we classify existing works into three categories:

  1. (1)

    纠正数据/类别不平衡Correcting data/class imbalance：这一类别是最相关的，因为他们还寻求纠正群体之间的效用不平衡。他们的核心思想是控制每组的梯度求和: This category is the most relevant as they also seek to correct utility imbalance across groups. Their core idea is to control the per-group summed gradients‖𝐆t,gn‖\left\|\mathbf{G}_{t,\textsl{g}_{n}}\right\|在条件。in Cond.1获得更平衡的梯度以减少MID和BOO。我们注意到，改编此类作品要么 (a) 违反 IDP 要求（例如，通过扩大或过度采样少数群体to obtain more balanced gradients to reduce MID and BOO. We note that adapting such works either (a) violate IDP requirements (e.g., by upscaling or oversampling the minority groups(He and Garcia, 2009)），(b) 国内流离失所者预算利用不足，总体效用较低（例如，通过缩小规模或对多数群体进行抽样不足), (b) under-utilize the IDP budgets and give lower overall utility (e.g., by downscaling or undersampling the majority groups(He and Garcia, 2009)), 或（c）通过裁剪消除它们的影响（例如，重新调整损失函数), or (c) have their effects eliminated by clipping (e.g., rescaling the loss function(Japkowicz, 2000)).

  2. (2)

    纠正 DP 加剧的精度差异Correcting DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity (Bagdasaryan et al., 2019; Tran et al., 2021a; Xu et al., 2021)：这些作品不能满足 IDP 的要求，而是针对 DP 削波和噪声添加的不同影响而定制的，但 IDP 引起的效用不平衡是由正交原因引起的。: These works do not satisfy IDP and are tailored to DP’s disparate impact from clipping and noise addition, yet IDP-induced utility imbalance arises from an orthogonal cause.

  3. (3)

    实现群体/个人的公平Achieving group/individual fairness：这些作品寻求实现类似的目标: These works seek to achieve similar预测/行为predictions/behaviors跨受保护群体，这与我们实现类似目标的目标有很大不同across protected groups, which greatly differs from our goal to achieve similar模型实用程序model utilities跨数据所有者。因此，我们不与此类作品进行比较。across data owners. Thus, we do not compare with this category of works.

因此，之前没有任何工作可以解决 IDP 引起的效用不平衡问题，或者可以轻松地进行调整来解决这一问题。我们的工作旨在填补这一空白，同时仍然坚持每个业主的 IDP 偏好。Thus, there is no prior work that addresses IDP-induced utility imbalance or can be easily adapted to do so. Our work seeks to fill this gap while still adhering to each owner’s IDP preference.

    an 有序加权平均ordered weighted average(OWA) 函数具有正的不增加权重。(OWA) function with positive non-increasing weights.Weymark (1981)表明这样的函数满足shows that such functions satisfy the庇古-道尔顿原理Pigou-Dalton principle (Pigou, 1912; Dalton, 1920)：如果模型可以通过增加另一个较小的个人损失（可能来自较不私有的所有者）来减少较大的个人损失（可能来自较私人的所有者），则 OWA 损失会减少。因此，最大限度地减少 OWA 损失可以减少具有不同 IDP 要求的所有者之间的不平衡。: if the model can reduce a larger individual loss (likely from a more private owner) by increasing another smaller individual loss (likely from a less private owner), the OWA loss decreases. 5 结论与讨论Conclusion and Discussion

We then propose theINO-SGD算法并从理论上分析其性质。最后，我们根据经验表明algorithm and theoretically analyze its properties. 道德声明Ethics Statement

本文提出的工作旨在推动该领域的发展 机器学习（ML）。特别是，它识别并解决 IDP 引起的效用不平衡问题，即经过训练的 ML 模型在部署期间对某些组的效用较低。这个问题是合理且重要的，因为模型所有者和受模型决策影响的此类群体中拥有数据的后续用户会受到负面影响。 此外，我们的工作强调数据隐私，这 保护个人隐私。因此，我们的研究 通过积极的社会促进道德人工智能 影响。This paper presents work whose goal is to advance the field of machine learning (ML). In particular, it identifies and addresses the problem of IDP-induced utility imbalance where the trained ML model has lower utilities on certain groups during deployment. This problem is justified and significant as the model owner and subsequent users with data in such groups who are impacted by the model decisions are negatively affected. Moreover, our work emphasizes data privacy, which protects the privacy of individuals. Therefore, our research promotes ethical AI with positive societal impact.

A.3 使用案例Use Cases

在本节中，我们将解释为什么这项工作在现实生活中很重要。In this section, we explain why this work is important in real life.不同的群体或数据所有者有不同的隐私偏好是很常见的。It is common for different groups or data owners to have different privacy preferences.具有某些属性值/类标签的数据所有者 当因隐私攻击而导致数据泄露时（例如，被污名化的疾病、种族）可能比其他人处于更不利的地位，因为这可能会给他们带来歧视或拒绝服务Data owners with certain attribute values/class labels (e.g., stigmatized diseases, race) could be more disadvantaged than others when data leakage occurs out of privacy attack, as this may bring them discrimination or denial of services(Best and Arseniev-Koehler, 2023; Lai and Tanner, 2022)。由于 DP 在这些领域与保护隐私高度相关，因此我们工作的用例非常广泛。例如，位于疾病爆发中心的医院将有更多的阳性病例，并且需要比位于较远的医院更强的隐私来保护患者。同样，来自边缘化背景的学生可能更喜欢更强的隐私；讨论更敏感话题的社交媒体用户可能希望他们的个人资料有更强的隐私性；信用记录不佳的个人可能需要更强的隐私，以避免不必要的机会损失。. Since DP is highly relevant in such fields to protect their privacy, our work’s use cases are broad. For example, a hospital located at the center of a disease outbreak will have much more positive cases and require stronger privacy than a hospital located far away to protect their patients. Similarly, students from marginalized backgrounds may prefer stronger privacy; social media users discussing more sensitive topics may desire stronger privacy on their profiles; individuals with poor credit histories may want stronger privacy to avoid unnecessary loss of opportunities.

更多私人数据所有者数据的模型效用是否应该更低？我们的答案是否定的。Should model utility on more private data owners’ data be lower? Our answer is no.如果经过训练的机器学习模型对数据空间内的某些数据组的效用较低，则模型所有者和使用该组数据的后续用户将受到负面影响。例如，考虑医疗机构针对污名化疾病训练疾病模型的情况。仅仅因为阳性病例数据所有者拥有更强的隐私性，并不意味着经过训练的模型在部署过程中应该对阳性病例组的数据表现不佳，因为后续受模型决策影响的阳性病例患者将承担后果。If the trained ML model has lower utility on some group of data within the data space, the model owner and subsequent users with data from such group will be negatively affected. For example, consider the case where a medical institute trains a disease model for a stigmatized disease. Just because positive-case data owners have stronger privacy does not mean the trained model should perform badly on data from positive-case groups during deployment, since subsequent positive-case patients who are affected by the model’s decisions will bear the consequences.

这项工作显示在第二节。This work shows in Sec.3.1IDP 可能会导致私有数据所有者和私有数据所有者之间严重的效用不平衡。由于以上原因，that IDP could induce severe utility imbalance between the more private data owners and the less private data owners. Because of the reasons above,这项工作的目标是纠正 IDP 引起的效用失衡the goal of this work is to correct IDP-induced utility imbalance，即提高更多私有数据所有者对应的最贫困群体的模型效用，并缩小更多私有数据所有者和较少私有数据所有者对应的群体的模型效用之间的差距。我们的解决方案, that is, to improve model utility on the worst-off groups corresponding to the more private data owners and reduce the gap between model utilities on groups corresponding to the more private data owners and the less private data owners. Our solutionINO-SGD在不牺牲整体模型实用性的情况下成功实现了这一目标。作为第一个此类工作，我们的工作做出了重大贡献。请注意，提高最差群体的效用（在部署期间）也是公平的一个重要目标successfully achieves this without sacrificing overall model utility. As the first such work, our work makes a significant contribution. Note that improving the utilities of worst-off groups (during deployment) is also an important goal in fairness(Dullerud et al., 2022; Zhao and Gordon, 2022)和分布稳健性and distributional robustness(Chen et al., 2023; Qiao et al., 2025).

IDP-SGD假设数据所有者是同质的。assumes homogeneous data owners.

解决不同隐私要求的一个简单方法是始终保持最强的 DP 级别。然而，这将不可避免地导致整体模型效用的损失（参见App.A naïve approach to address different privacy requirements is to always maintain the strongest DP level. However, this would inevitably lead to a loss in overall model utility (see App.FQ1 详细解释）。原来的Q1 for a detailed explanation). The originalIDP-SGD工作work(Boenisch et al., 2024)假设每个数据所有者都拥有相似的数据。不同的隐私偏好来自于他们的自然个性，周围assumes that each data owner holds similar data. The different privacy preferences come from their natural personalities, where around34%34\%的人更喜欢高隐私性，of people prefer high privacy,43%43\%更喜欢中等隐私并且prefer medium privacy and23%23\%更喜欢低隐私性prefer low privacy(Alaggan et al., 2016)。此设置适用于训练数据通常不太敏感的 ML 任务，例如表情符号建议。相比之下，我们的工作意识到数据的性质也可能导致不同的隐私偏好，并确定这可能导致严重的效用不平衡问题。. This setting is applicable to ML tasks where training data are in general not very sensitive such as emoji suggestion. In contrast, our work realizes that the nature of data could lead to different privacy preferences too and identifies that this may lead to a severe utility imbalance problem.

个性化的隐私进程。Individualized privacy progression.

我们还预见到我们工作的另一个潜在用例并将其视为We also foresee another potential use case of our work and recognize it as个性化隐私进程individualized privacy progression（IPP）。 IPP 捕获隐私偏好随时间的变化。由于隐私与实用性的权衡(IPP). IPP captures the change of privacy preferences over time. Due to the privacy-utility tradeoff(Makhdoumi and Fawaz, 2013)，指定低隐私预算（导致低效用模型）的所有者可能会后悔他们之前的选择，并希望增加他们的隐私预算。相反，设定高隐私预算的所有者可能会越来越意识到或厌恶隐私泄露的风险，并希望降低其隐私预算。当数据所有者希望增加隐私预算时，他们可能会根据数据的敏感性进行不同程度的增加。如果数据所有者希望减少隐私预算（假设模型尚未受到攻击），则需要将 ML 模型回滚到训练过程中较早的时间戳。这强调了在整个模型训练过程中保持良好的学习动态的重要性。, owners who specify low privacy budgets (resulting in low-utility models) may regret their previous choices and wish to increase their privacy budgets. Conversely, owners who set high privacy budgets may become increasingly aware of or averse to the risks of privacy leakage and desire to lower their privacy budgets. When data owners wish to increase their privacy budgets, they may do so to varying degrees based on the sensitivity of their data. If data owners wish to decrease their privacy budgets (assuming that the model has not been attacked yet), the ML model needs to be rolled back to an earlier timestamp in the training process. This reinforces the importance of maintaining a good learning dynamics throughout the model training process.

的The采样高斯机制sampled Gaussian mechanism(SGM) 是最常见的 DP 机制之一，可转换任何非私有算法(SGM) is one of the most common DP mechanisms which converts any non-private algorithm𝒜\mathcal{A}到满足DP的一个。它有两个组成部分，to one that satisfies DP. It has two components, the噪声添加机制noise addition mechanism和and the抽样机制sampling mechanism.

噪声添加机制。Noise addition mechanism.

噪声添加机制是实现DP的最常用技术。它的工作原理是扰乱非私有算法的输出The noise addition mechanism is the most common technique to achieve DP. It works by perturbing the non-private algorithm output𝝎\bm{\omega}具有与相邻数据集给出的算法输出的差异相当的一定噪声强度，使得攻击者无法区分受扰动的输出。with certain noise of magnitude comparable to the difference in algorithm outputs given by neighboring datasets, such that the perturbed outputs become indistinguishable to attackers.

B.3 不平衡与公平概念的比较Comparison of Imbalance and Fairness Notions

在本节中，我们讨论与群体间效用不平衡相关的各种概念，包括In this section, we discuss various notions related to utility imbalance across groups, including(1)纠正数据/类别不平衡；correcting data/class imbalance;(2)纠正 DP 加剧的精度差异correcting DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity(Bagdasaryan et al., 2019);和; and(3)实现群体/个人的公平。我们将解释我们的工作（重点关注国内流离失所者引起的效用不平衡/准确性差异）与以下因素相关的原因和方式：achieving group/individual fairness. We will explain why and how our work, which focuses on IDP-induced utility imbalance/accuracy disparity, is related to(1)，有些相关但又不同, somewhat related to but different from(2)并显着不同于and significantly different from(3).

(1)数据/类别不平衡。(1) Data/class imbalance.

正如主论文中所介绍的，数据不平衡是指（†）训练集中不同组的大小不平衡，其中每个组优化不同的目标（例如，每个组拥有一个类（即类不平衡）或一个多数类比其他组多得多）。关于 (i) 的现有工作可大致分为两类：As introduced in the main paper, data imbalance refers to (†) the imbalance in sizes of different groups in the training set, where each group optimizes a different objective (e.g., each group holds a class (i.e., class imbalance) or a lot more of one majority class over the others). Existing works on (i) can be broadly grouped into two categories:数据明智的方法data-wise approaches和and优化方法optimization-wise approaches。数据明智的方法. Data-wise approaches(He and Garcia, 2009)专注于在每次迭代时操纵原始数据集或采样数据的分布，以使每组的梯度数量相似。focus on manipulating the distribution of original dataset or sampled data at each iteration, so that the number of gradients for each group is similar.过采样Oversampling其工作原理是从少数群体中采样更多数据，但由于更多私人数据所有者的隐私预算有限，因此在 IDP 下不可行。works by sampling more data from the minority groups, but is infeasible under IDP due to the limited privacy budget of more private data owners.欠采样Undersampling它的工作原理是从多数群体中选择较少的数据，并使其数量与少数群体相当，但也不适合 IDP，因为当数据已经稀缺时，它会恶化模型的效用。 另一方面，优化方法侧重于修改优化目标或算法。作品多works by selecting fewer data from the majority group and making their quantity comparable to the minority group, but is also unsuitable under IDP as it would worsen the model utility when data are already scarce. Optimization-wise approaches, on the other hand, focus on modifying the optimization objectives or algorithms. Many works(Japkowicz, 2000; Lin et al., 2017)尝试重新调整损失函数以获得不同组的不同幅度的梯度，但它们的影响将通过 DP/IDP 中的梯度裁剪来消除。attempt to rescale the loss function in order to obtain gradients of different magnitudes for different groups, but their effects will be eliminated by gradient clipping in DP/IDP.Anand et al. (1993)和andFrancazi et al. (2023)直接重新调整获得的梯度以平衡每组的梯度，但这反过来会改变rescale the obtained gradients directly to balance gradients from each group, but this will in turn change the modular sensitivity ofIDP-SGD从而违反了算法的隐私要求。and hence violate the privacy requirement of the algorithm.

我们想重申一下We would like to restate that我们的设置有所不同，因为我们不假设 (†)our setting differs as we do not assume (†)，尽管我们认为数据不平衡是一个密切相关的问题，因为它们都表现出 MID 和 BOO。, though we recognize data imbalance as a closely related problem since they both exhibit MID and BOO.

(2) DP-加剧了精度差距。(2) DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity.

Bagdasaryan et al. (2019)首先确定，如果训练集中存在代表性不足的群体（即 (†) 训练集不平衡），则使用 DP 算法进行训练将使此类群体在训练后的 ML 模型中的代表性更加不足，这反映为来自此类群体的数据的准确性/效用更低（因此称为“DP 加剧”）。特别是，它解释了 DP 的削波和噪声添加如何共同导致如此不同的影响，并加剧代表性良好的群体和代表性不足的群体之间的准确性差异。相反，我们的工作并不假设 (†) 训练集不平衡。相反，我们发现 IDP 本身会导致效用失衡。因此，first identifies that if there exist underrepresented groups in the training set (i.e., (†) the training set is imbalanced), training with DP algorithms would make such groups even more underrepresented in the trained ML model, which is reflected as even lower accuracy/utility on data from such groups (thus the term “DP-exacerbated”). In particular, it explains how clipping and noise addition of DP jointly lead to such a disparate impact and worsen accuracy disparity between the well-represented groups and underrepresented groups. In contrast, our work does not assume (†) the training set is imbalanced. Instead, we identify that IDP itself can induce utility imbalance. Thus,我们的工作与 DP 加剧的准确性差异工作线正交our work is orthogonal to the DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity line of works。由于我们的工作也在 (I)DP 下运作，因此我们使用不同的术语“效用不平衡”以避免混淆。. Since our work also operates under (I)DP, we use a different term “utility imbalance” to avoid confusion.

尽管如此，由于 (ii) 和我们的工作都解决了准确性差异/效用不平衡问题，因此我们对 DP 加剧的准确性差异的现有工作进行了快速回顾。 我们彻底审查后续工作Nevertheless, since (ii) and our work both address accuracy disparity/utility imbalance, we give a quick review of existing works on DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity. We thoroughly examine follow-up works of(Bagdasaryan et al., 2019)并将它们分类如下。and classify them as follows.(Farrand et al., 2020; Ganev, 2021; Ganev et al., 2022; Uniyal et al., 2022)从理论上/经验上分析 DP 加剧的精度差异问题。analyze the problem of DP-exacerbated accuracy disparity theoretically/empirically.Tran et al. (2021a)使用另一种目标函数，该函数惩罚组中不同的（剪切的）梯度和（痕迹）Hessians，作者将其视为 DP 不同影响的来源；uses an alternative objective function which penalizes different (clipped) gradients and (trace of) Hessians among groups, which the authors identify as sources of the disparate impact of DP;Xu et al. (2021)使用额外的隐私成本计算不同数据的不同裁剪阈值，以控制每个数据的贡献；computes different clipping thresholds for different data using additional privacy costs in order to control the contribution of each datum;Esipova et al. (2023)在每次迭代中花费额外的隐私预算来计算严格的裁剪边界（大于裁剪阈值）并丢弃大于裁剪边界的梯度；spends additional privacy budgets at each iteration to compute a strict clipping bound (that is larger than the clipping threshold) and discards the gradients larger than the clipping bound;Kulynych et al. (2022)根据组大小对每组数据进行重要性采样；adopts importance sampling on each group’s data based on the group size;Knolle et al. (2023)在损失函数中添加了一个正则化项，该项会惩罚较大的个体梯度范数，这些范数在剪裁时会带来更大的偏差。 值得注意的是，这些工作在标准 DP 下运行，并假设所有数据所有者都有统一的隐私预算。因此，额外的隐私成本对每个所有者的影响是相同的。然而，在 IDP 环境中，同样的额外隐私成本消耗了更多私人数据所有者的隐私预算的更大一部分，这加剧了 IDP 引起的效用不平衡，正如我们在第 2 节中新指出的那样。adds a regularizing term to the loss function that penalizes large individual gradient norms which bring larger bias when clipped. Notably, these works operate under standard DP and assume uniform privacy budgets across all data owners. Thus, the impact of an additional privacy cost is the same for each owner. In the IDP setting, however, the same additional privacy cost consumes a larger fraction of the more private data owners’ privacy budgets, which worsens the IDP-induced utility imbalance as we had novelly pointed out in Sec.3.1。此外，这些工作是针对 DP 的削波和噪声附加组件造成的不同影响而定制的，而我们的效用不平衡是由正交原因引起的。因此，它们无法解决国内流离失所者引起的效用失衡问题。例如，当使用. Moreover, these works are tailored to the disparate impact of DP caused by its clipping and noise addition components, while our utility imbalance arises from an orthogonal cause. Thus, they cannot address IDP-induced utility imbalance. For example, when usingTran et al. (2021a)的替代目标函数，不同的采样率和/或裁剪阈值引入’s alternative objective function, the different sampling rates and/or clipping thresholds introduced byIDP-SGD仍可能导致 MID、BOO 和效用失衡。最后但并非最不重要的一点是，目前尚不清楚如何改编这些作品来满足 IDP 的需求。could still lead to MID, BOO and utility imbalance. Last but not least, it is unclear how these works can even be adapted to satisfy IDP.

Our solution, theINO-SGD算法，旨在在不损害整体模型效用的情况下尽可能多地增加左侧。通过降低每批中不太重要的数据的权重，algorithm, aims to increase the left-hand side as much as possible without hurting the overall model utility. By down-weighting the less important data within each batch,INO-SGD凭经验降低限幅阈值is empirically reducing the clipping thresholdsCnC_{n}以一种战略性的方式为不太私有的数据所有者提供服务，通过充分利用每个所有者的隐私预算，不会对整体模型效用造成任何损失。for the less private data owners in a strategic way that incurs no penalty on overall model utility by fully utilizing each owner’s privacy budget.

假设的合理性。Justification of assumptions.我们在 Thm 中的假设。Our assumptions in Thm.3.1是合理的并且符合现有的不平衡/DP文献。每个所有者目标函数的平滑度假设通常用于表征进行参数更新时损失的变化，作为比凸性或强凸性限制性较小的假设。它被用在最近的不平衡作品中，例如are reasonable and in line with existing imbalance/DP literatures. The smoothness assumption on each owner’s objective function is often used to characterize the change in loss when a parameter update is made, as a less restrictive assumption than convexity or strong convexity. It is used in recent imbalance works such as(Francazi et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2025)和 DP 作品如and DP works such as(Arora et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2020b; Das et al., 2023; Sha et al., 2024)。均匀有界假设用于限制采样梯度中的随机性，广泛应用于优化，尤其是裁剪、文献中. The uniform boundedness assumption is used to bound the stochastic in the sampled gradients, which is widely used in optimization, especially clipping, literature(Li et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2020; 2019).

C.2 的TheINO-SGD算法Algorithm

C.2.1 直接方法的不适用性Unsuitability of Straightforward Approaches

在本节中，我们列出了一系列简单的方法来解决国内流离失所者引起的效用不平衡问题，乍一看可能会考虑这些方法。我们将争论为什么它们都不够充分：In this section, we give a list of straightforward approaches to address IDP-induced utility imbalance that might be considered at first glance. We will argue why all of them are inadequate:

  • •

    为所有业主执行最低的隐私预算Enforcing the lowest privacy budget for all owners（例如，通过欠采样或使用较小的限幅阈值）：这种方法与(e.g., by undersampling or using a smaller clipping thresholds): This approach aligns withDP-SGD，与 IDP 预算相比，其整体模型效用明显较低, which under-utilizes IDP budgets and has a significantly lower overall model utility compared toIDP-SGD (Boenisch et al., 2024)（参见应用程序中的经验证据。(see empirical evidence in App.D.4.3）。我们的算法将充分利用每个所有者的 IDP 预算。). Our algorithm will fully utilize each owners’ IDP budgets instead.

  • •

    随机缩小隐私预算较高的业主规模Randomly downscaling owners with higher privacy budgets（例如，通过降低权重或欠采样）：这种方法有几个问题。首先，对于多个数据所有者和隐私预算，目前尚不清楚如何设置（i）较少和较多私人所有者之间的界限以及（ii）每个较少私人所有者的缩减程度。对于(i)，例如，对于(e.g., by down-weighting or undersampling): This approach has several issues. Firstly, for multiple data owners and privacy budgets, it is unclear how to set (i) the cutoff between less and more private owners and (ii) how much to downscale from each less private owner. For (i), for example, for1010拥有者owners withϵn∈[0.5,5]\epsilon_{n}\in[0.5,5]均匀，不适合直接使用均值evenly, it is unsuitable to directly use the mean2.252.25作为截止点，因为隐私的影响不与隐私预算线性扩展并且难以量化as the cutoff since the impact of privacy does not scale linearly with privacy budgets and is hard to quantify先验的a priori;对于（ii），以相同的方式从业主那里缩小规模; for (ii), downscaling in the same way from owners withϵn=3\epsilon_{n}=3和andϵn=5\epsilon_{n}=5不合适，因为这两者之间仍然存在不平衡，并且缩小了所有者的规模is unsuitable, as there is still imbalance between these two and downscaling owner33与业主相比遭受不同的效用损失incurs different utility loss than owner55。由于 (i) 和 (ii)，当有. Due to (i) and (ii), when there areNN所有者，找到要删除的最佳数据数量owners, finding the optimal number of data to drop from每个each业主要求owner requiresO​(N)O(N)超参数，使得该方法不够充分。其次，这种方法也没有充分利用 IDP 预算，并导致整体模型效用较差。我们在 App 中提供经验证据。hyperparameters, making the approach inadequate. Secondly, this approach also under-utilizes IDP budgets and leads to a worse overall model utility. We provide empirical evidence in App.D.1.3和应用程序。and App.D.4.3。第三，当来自较少私人所有者的一些数据仍然具有较高损失（例如，难以预测的数据）时，随机缩小规模会导致效用失衡恶化，这是不希望的。我们的算法会根据数据的损失对数据进行排序，以识别我们应该完全保留的重要数据。这是合理的，因为批次中每个数据的梯度信息的重要性. Thirdly, when some data from less private owners still have higher loss (e.g., a harder-to-predict one), randomly downscaling would undesirably worsen utility imbalance. Our algorithm would order data by their losses to identify the important data we should fully keep. C.2.2 替代排序顺序Alternative Sorting Orders

在主要论文中，我们建议使用损失顺序来对每批数据的重要性进行排名。然而，它实际上可以与许多其他排序顺序一起使用，因为它是一个In the main paper we propose using the order of loss to rank the importance of data within each batch. However, it can in fact work with many other sorting orders since it is an伊诺-SGMINO-SGM机制如第 2 节所述。mechanism as introduced in Sec.3.3.1和应用程序。and App.C.3.2.

一个例子是混合顺序：我们可以主要根据数据的所有权对数据进行排名（即，来自更私有的数据所有者的数据排名更高），然后是每个所有者内的损失值。这样，理想情况下，来自更私密数据的梯度将始终排名非常高，并且它们永远不会落入尾部区域并被丢弃或降低权重。然而，我们发现这个顺序的表现不如直接使用损失顺序：One example is a mixed order: we may rank data primarily based on their ownership (i.e., data from the more private data owners are ranked higher) followed by loss values within each owner. In this way, ideally, gradients from the more private data will always be ranked very high and they will never fall into the tail region and be discarded or down-weighted. However, we find that this order does not perform as well as directly using the order of loss:

  • •

    有时，较少私人所有者的数据可能难以学习，并且仍然会造成巨大损失，反之亦然。Sometimes, the less private owner’s data can be difficult to learn and still have large losses and vice versa.INO-SGD使用此顺序会通过为这些数据分配较低的重要性分数来降低这些数据的权重。using this order would undesirably downweight such data by assigning them low importance scores.

  • •

    最不私有者的数据总是处于尾部，并且永远无法被学习。例如，在我们的The least private owner’s data are always at the tail, and they could never be learnt. For example, in ourCM-PC实验（见App.experiments (see App.D.1）与) with1010数据所有者，最不私有的所有者data owners, the least private owner1010的最大准确度仅为’s maximum accuracy is only0.2%0.2\%在整个学习动态中都使用这个顺序，这意味着它的数据总是被严重降低权重并且几乎无法学习。throughout the learning dynamics using this order, which means that its data is always severely down-weighted and barely learnt.

C.2.4 运行时间为Runtime ofINO-SGD

我们强调，尽管有额外的操作，即排序和积分，INO-SGD 的运行时间与 IDP-SGD 的运行时间没有太大区别：We highlight that the runtime of INO-SGD does not differ much from that of IDP-SGD despite the additional operations, i.e., sorting and integrating:

  • •

    IDP-SGD 和 INO-SGD 共享最昂贵的步骤，包括反向传播和每样本梯度处理（裁剪）。The most costly steps, including backpropagation and per-sample gradient processing (clipping) are shared by both IDP-SGD and INO-SGD.

  • •

    批量排序梯度所需的时间The time taken to sort the gradients in batchBtB_{t} is 𝒪​(|Bt|​log⁡|Bt|)\mathcal{O}(|B_{t}|\log|B_{t}|)，与反向传播时间相比可以忽略不计。, which is negligible compared with the backpropagation time.

Theλ\lambda-level CVaR是指只有top的数据时的平均损失-level CVaR refers to the average loss when only the data with top100​λ%100\lambda\%损失仍然保留在数据集中（即losses remain in the dataset (i.e.,100​λ%100\lambda\%最坏情况尾部损失），混合 CVaR 表示不同条件下 CVaR 的加权平均值worst-case tail of losses) and the mixed CVaR represents a weighted average of CVaRs at differentλ∈(0,1]\lambda\in(0,1]（即最坏情况的不同严重程度）。因此，经过训练的模型将提高损失较大的数据的性能，这些损失可能属于更多的私人所有者。(i.e., different severity of worst-case). DRO studies how to preserve robust model performance if the actual data distribution during ML model deployment is different from the training data distribution. To achieve this, one typical solution is to consider distributions of training data that are different from the training set itself and train a model that can minimize the maximum loss among all these distributions. D.1.2 模型和训练Models and Training

在主要论文中，对于视觉数据集（MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 CIFAR-100-FV），我们使用了一组提出的卷积神经网络（CNN）模型In the main paper, for vision datasets (MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and CIFAR-100-FV), we use a set of convolutional neural network (CNN) models proposed byPapernot et al. (2021)迎合 DP-ML 并在现有文献中广泛使用which cater to DP-ML and are widely used in existing literature(Tramèr and Boneh, 2021; Boenisch et al., 2024)。这些 CNN 模型比 VGG 等流行模型更小. These CNN models are smaller than popular models such as VGG(Simonyan and Zisserman, 2014)或 ResNetor ResNet(He et al., 2016)，但更适合 DP-ML，因为添加的高斯噪声的（预期）幅度（取自, but are more suitable for DP-ML because the (expected) magnitude of added Gaussian noise (drawn from𝒩​(0,σ2​𝐈r×r)\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}\mathbf{I}_{r\times r})) 随着模型参数数量的增加而增加) increases with the number of model parametersrr。此外，他们还使用 Tanh 激活函数，该函数在 DP-ML 中表现更好。 我们通过考虑更复杂的模型和嵌入（例如 ResNet-18）来补充这些 CNN 实验. Also, they use Tanh activation functions which are shown to perform better in DP-ML. We supplement these CNN experiments by considering more complex models and embeddings such as ResNet-18(He et al., 2016)和 SimCLRv2and SimCLRv2(Chen et al., 2020a)。对于语言数据集（姓氏），我们使用字符级长短期记忆（LSTM）模型. For language dataset (Surnames), we use a character-level long short-term memory (LSTM) model fromBoenisch et al. (2024)，这是一种递归神经网络 (RNN) 模型，它将每个姓氏视为字符序列（即字母和特殊字符）。, which is a type of recurrent neural network (RNN) model that treats each surname as a sequence of characters (i.e., letters and special characters).

D.1.3 基线的选择Choice of Baseline

由于这是第一项认识和解决国内流离失所者引起的效用不平衡的工作，因此之前没有任何工作可以缓解该问题并适合作为基准。因此，我们在所有实验中与最重要的基线 IDP-SGD 进行比较。Since this is the first work that recognizes and addresses IDP-induced utility imbalance, there is no prior work that mitigates the problem and is suitable as baseline. Therefore, we compare against the most important baseline IDP-SGD in all experiments.

在秒。In Sec.3.1和应用程序。and App.C.2.1，我们已经解释了为什么现有的解决效用不平衡的技术（无论是在非私人还是私人环境中）既不能满足 IDP 的要求，也不能轻易适应这一点。除此之外，我们还解释了为什么解决数据不平衡问题的常用技术, we have explained why existing techniques addressing utility imbalance (either in non-private or private setting) neither satisfy IDP nor can be easily adapted to do so. To add on, we explain why common techniques to address data imbalance in the非私人的non-private设置是setting are不适合not suitable在 IDP 设置中：in the IDP setting:

For neighboring datasetsDD和andDdD^{d}，如果丢弃算法是确定性的，则生成的数据集, if the dropping algorithm is deterministic, the resulting datasetsD′D^{\prime}和andDd′\smash{{D^{d}}^{\prime}}可能不是相邻的，因此即使攻击者也可以识别may not be neighboring, thus can be identified by attackers even ifIDP-SGD应用于is applied toD′D^{\prime}和andDd′\smash{{D^{d}}^{\prime}};如果丢弃算法是随机的，则生成的数据集; if the dropping algorithm is randomized, the resulting datasetsD′D^{\prime}和andDd′\smash{{D^{d}}^{\prime}}可能不遵循类似的分布，因此也可以被识别。因此，设计一种保留 IDP 的丢弃算法仍然很重要，这超出了本工作的范围。may not follow a similar distribution, thus can be identified too. Therefore, it remains non-trivial to design a dropping algorithm that preserves IDP, which is beyond the scope of this work.

在模型所有者可以同时纠正效用不平衡和提高/保持整体模型效用的区域之外（这仅Beyond the region where the model owner can simultaneously correct utility imbalance and improve/preserve overall model utility (which onlyINO-SGD可以实现），模型所有者还可以选择更积极地设置 TIF（例如，通过设置更大的尾部长度来降低更多不太重要的梯度的权重）can achieve), the model owner can also choose to set the TIF more aggressively (e.g., downweighting more of the less important gradients by setting a larger tail lengthγ\gamma）以便交易总体效用以进一步纠正效用不平衡。在此用例中，方法 A 被认为是) in order to trade overall utility to further correct for utility imbalance. In this use case, method A is said to帕累托支配Pareto-dominate方法 B 如果在任何总体效用水平上，方法 A 比方法 B 更好地纠正效用不平衡；在任何效用不平衡水平下，方法 A 的总体效用都高于方法 B。method B if at any level of overall utility, method A corrects for utility imbalance better than method B; at any level of utility imbalance, method A achieves a higher overall utility than method B. In Fig.20，我们证明, we demonstrate thatINO-SGD帕累托主导的满足 IDP 的朴素方法。Pareto-dominates naïve methods that satisfy IDP.特别是，我们控制In particular, we control theINO-SGD通过使用不同尾部长度进行权衡’s tradeoff by using different tail lengthγ\gamma，并考虑每个数据所有者按比例减少其隐私预算的基线（例如通过, and consider the baseline where every data owner decreases their privacy budgets proportionately (e.g. by10%10\%, 20%20\%, 30%30\%, 40%40\%）来匹配最私人的所有者，我们使用每组召回的标准差来衡量效用不平衡。正如隐私与实用性的权衡一样) to match the most private owner, and we use the standard deviation across per-group recalls to measure utility imbalance. Just as the privacy-utility tradeoff(Makhdoumi and Fawaz, 2013)描述，减少隐私预算会导致整体效用降低，因此此类方法无法实现效用平衡和整体效用的双重改进，如下所示：describes, decreasing privacy budgets would incur lower overall utility, so such methods cannot achieve a dual improvement in both utility balance and overall utility asINO-SGD实现。即使模型所有者愿意交易一些整体效用来进一步纠正效用不平衡，achieves. Even if the model owner is willing to trade some overall utility to further correct for utility imbalance,INO-SGD是一个更好的解决方案，因为它具有帕累托优越性。is a better solution because of its Pareto superiority.

E.1 局限性Limitations

在本节中，我们将解释一些可能的限制In this section, we explain some possible limitations of theINO-SGD算法并讨论其原因和未来可能的方向。algorithm and discuss their causes and possible future directions.

首先，增加更多私人所有者的效用可能不可避免地减少较少私人所有者的效用。这是因为我们必须削弱私人所有者较少的梯度的主导地位才能实现等式：Firstly, increasing the utility of more private owners might unavoidably reduce that of the less private owners. This is because we have to weaken the dominance of gradients from the less private owners in order to achieve Eq.5，缓解 MID 和 BOO，并解决 IDP 引起的效用不平衡问题。庇古-道尔顿原理中也考虑了权衡的必要性, mitigate MID and BOO, and address IDP-induced utility imbalance. The need for tradeoff is also considered in the Pigou-Dalton principle(Pigou, 1912)：如果我们想提高更多私人数据所有者的模型效用，从而减少所有所有者的效用不平衡，我们必须将一些资源从不太私人的所有者转移到更私人的所有者。为了减轻这种限制并控制权衡: if we want to improve the model utility for the more private data owners and hence make the utilities for all owners less imbalanced, we must transfer some resources from the less private owners to the more private ones. E.2 IDP-平衡-效用权衡The IDP-Balance-Utility Tradeoff

我们的实验表明Our experiment has shown thatINO-SGD取得比achieves a better learning dynamics thanIDP-SGD，但似乎改进有些有限（即，它不会为每个数据所有者带来相同的性能），这似乎使我们的贡献有限。然而，在本节中，我们将简要讨论 IDP-平衡-效用权衡，并证明为什么不可能在不损失整体模型效用的情况下为每个数据所有者实现相同的性能。, but it seems that the improvement is somewhat limited (i.e., it does not result in equal performance for every data owner), which seemingly makes our contribution limited. However, in this section, we will briefly discuss the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff and justify why it is not possible to achieve equal performance for every data owner without loss of overall model utility.

DP的不同影响The disparate impact of DP(Bagdasaryan et al., 2019)一直是限制 DP-ML 模型性能的众所周知的缺点。它指的是DP-ML模型对训练集中代表性不足的群体给出的准确率要低得多的现象，并且众所周知，由于DP的性质，这是不可避免的：因为我们需要保护每个数据的隐私，所以我们不能特意使代表性不足的群体可识别。唯一的解决方法是对代表性过高的群体进行抽样不足并浪费他们的一些隐私预算，以实现“相似的效用” 让比例过高的群体表现更差。这种情况被称为隐私-差异-效用权衡。在国内流离失所者中，情况变得更糟。在秒。has been a well-known drawback that limits the performance of DP-ML models. It refers to the phenomenon that DP-ML models give much lower accuracy for underrepresented groups in the training set, and it is known to be unavoidable due to the nature of DP: since we need to protect the privacy of every datum, we cannot specially make the underrepresented groups identifiable. The only workaround is to undersample the overrepresented groups and waste some of their privacy budgets, so as to achieve “similar utility” by giving the overrepresented groups much worse performance. This situation is known as the privacy-disparity-utility tradeoff. In IDP, the situation becomes even worse. In Sec.3.1，我们解释说，即使原始训练集是平衡的并且不存在代表性不足的群体，IDP也会因为个性化的隐私偏好而强行创建代表性不足的群体。因此，我们预计 IDP 中的隐私-差异-效用权衡会比普通 DP 更糟糕。图。, we explain that even if the original training set is balanced and there is no underrepresented group, IDP would forcefully create underrepresented groups because of the individualized privacy preferences. Therefore, we are expected to see a worse privacy-disparity-utility tradeoff in IDP than vanilla DP. Fig.23给出了这样一个直观的解释gives an intuitive explanation of suchIDP-平衡-效用权衡IDP-balance-utility tradeoff.

我们的工作成功地接近了 IDP-余额-效用权衡的边界Our work successfully gets closer to the boundary of the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff，因为我们能够在不损失整体模型效用的情况下实现更好的平衡。尽管如此，我们仍然面临着 IDP-余额-公用事业的权衡。其实可以参考图一。, because we are able to achieve better balance without losing the overall model utility. Nonetheless, we are still facing the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff. In fact, one can refer to Fig.16(a)和and16(b)可视化我们对 IDP-平衡-效用权衡的贡献。当尾巴的长度to visualize our contribution to the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff. When the length of tailγ<100\gamma<100，我们在不牺牲整体模型性能的情况下实现了更好的平衡。这意味着原来的, we are achieving a better balance without sacrificing overall model performance. This means that the originalIDP-SGD没有达到 IDP-余额-效用权衡界限，而我们的does not hit the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff bound while ourINO-SGD做得更好。然而，当尾巴的长度does better. However, when the length of tailγ≥100\gamma\geq 100，虽然效用不平衡仍在减少，但整体模型性能也呈现快速下降。这就是我们到达帕累托边界并经历 IDP-平衡-效用权衡的地方。, although the utility imbalance is still decreasing, the overall model performance shows a rapid drop too. This is where we reach our Pareto frontier and experience the IDP-balance-utility tradeoff.

附录FAppendix F其他问题Other Questions

  1. 1.

    为什么要考虑个性化的隐私设置？为什么每个业主不选择最高隐私级别？Why do we consider the individualized privacy setting? Why would each owner not choose the maximum privacy level?

    研究Research(Berendt et al., 2005; Jensen et al., 2005)已表明has shown不同数据所有者的隐私偏好可能有所不同privacy preferences can vary across different data owners。此外，具有更敏感属性（例如，被污名化的疾病、种族）的数据所有者更喜欢更强的隐私，因为数据泄露会使他们遭受歧视或拒绝或服务. Moreover, data owners with more sensitive attributes (e.g., stigmatized diseases, race) would prefer stronger privacy as data leakage would expose them to discrimination or denial or services(Best and Arseniev-Koehler, 2023; Lai and Tanner, 2022)。我们在App中提供了一些现实生活中的应用程序。. We have provided several real life applications in App.A.3.

    然而，选择最大隐私级别是不可取的： 的However, choosing the maximum privacy level is undesirable: The隐私与效用的权衡privacy-utility tradeoff (Makhdoumi and Fawaz, 2013)经过充分研究，结果表明使用更强的 DP 保证会降低训练后的 ML 模型的性能（效用）。 因此，模型所有者希望在较弱的隐私下使用每个数据所有者的数据来训练具有最高效用的模型。在某些情况下，例如协作 MLis well-studied and shows that using a stronger DP guarantees undesirably reduces the performance (utility) of the trained ML model. Thus, a model owner would want to use each data owner’s data at a weaker privacy to train a model with the highest utility. In some cases such as collaborative ML(Sim et al., 2020; Tian et al., 2024)，数据所有者也是经过训练的 ML 模型的用户，因此他们会选择他们认为可以接受的最高隐私预算（例如，当数据所有者是医院，模型所有者是训练 ML 模型来预测心脏病风险的医疗机构时）。在其他情况下， 模型所有者可以根据数据所有者的数据价值或隐私预算奖励每个数据所有者，从而激励数据所有者选择他们认为可以接受的最高隐私预算（即，选择较高的隐私预算和较弱的隐私将导致更多的货币补偿）。, data owners are also the users of trained ML models and hence they will choose the highest privacy budgets they find acceptable (e.g., when data owners are hospitals and the model owner is a medical institute who trains an ML model to predict the risk of heart disease). In other case, model owners can incentivize data owners to choose the highest privacy budgets they find acceptable by rewarding each data owner based on their data values or privacy budgets (i.e., selecting a higher privacy budget and weaker privacy will lead to more monetary compensation).

  2. 2.

    为什么效用不平衡问题（以及提高更多私人所有者或困难数据的效用）很重要？Why is the problem of the utility imbalance (and improving the utility on more private owners or difficult data) important?

    正如第 2 节中的动机。As motivated in Sec.1，模型所有者需要从多个数据所有者收集数据，以便收集足够的数据来训练良好的 ML 模型。此外，拥有独特而敏感数据的数据所有者更喜欢更强的隐私，而模型所有者并不希望这样做，因为这会导致这些独特数据的模型效用较低。例如，在医疗保健机器学习应用中，患有某些罕见疾病的数据所有者可能需要严格的隐私要求。然而，训练这样的机器学习模型的目标恰恰是很好地预测这些罕见疾病，而不是很好地预测没有疾病的对照患者。因此，模型所有者应该考虑使用, model owners need to collect data from multiple data owners in order to gather sufficient data to train a good ML model. Moreover, data owners with unique yet sensitive data would prefer a stronger privacy, which is not desired by model owners as this would lead to low model utility on these unique data. For example, in healthcare ML applications, data owners with some rare disease are likely to demand strong privacy requirements. However, the goal of training such an ML model is precisely to predict these rare diseases well instead of predicting well for control patients without the diseases. Thus, the model owner should consider usingINO-SGD提高这些更困难的例子和更多私人数据所有者的效用。to improve the utility on these more difficult examples and more private data owners.
